label: Netgear M4250-9G1F-PoE+ (GSM4210PD)
description: Netgear AV Line desktop switch: 8x 1G PoE+ (110 W) + 1x 1G RJ45 + 1x 1G SFP, plus a 1G out-of-band management port and a USB-C console. 20 Gbps fabric, fanless, external 130 W power adapter, 210 x 140 x 40 mm.

fabric.note: Vendor 20 Gbps non-blocking fabric across 10 ports (8 x 1G PoE+ + 1 x 1G RJ45 + 1 x 1G SFP), i.e. 10 Gbit/s each way; forwarding rate 14.88 Mpps, line rate.

poe.note: 110 W shared across the 8 PoE+ ports: the datasheet gives 802.3at on every copper port 1-8, so the port maxima (8 x 30 W = 240 W) exceed the budget by more than 2:1 - the budget binds, not the port count.

notes: M4250 series common platform: 16K MAC addresses, 4K ARP/NDP entries, 4K VLANs, static routes (894 IPv4 / 126 IPv6) plus RIP (32 IPv4), DHCP server (2K leases), sFlow, SNMP, console/telnet/SSH CLI and the AV web GUI. Desktop form factor, totally fanless, external 130 W adapter (C13 inlet). Console is USB-C only - there is no RJ45 RS232 console on the desktop models, so a console lead for this box is not a rollover cable. 1G out-of-band RJ45 management port and a USB-A storage port. This is the only M4250 with eight PoE+ ports plus both a non-PoE copper port and a 1G SFP cage; its sibling M4250-8G2XF-PoE+ trades the copper port and the 1G SFP for two 10G SFP+ cages. Sources: datasheet https://www.downloads.netgear.com/files/GDC/M4250/M4250_Datasheet.pdf (Hardware-at-a-Glance, Components and Modules, specification table) and https://kb.netgear.com/000064904/NETGEAR-AV-Line-of-Fully-Managed-Switches-M4250-Series.
